avoid_supplements.name: Yohimbine
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Antagonizes alpha-1 blockade effects; yohimbine is an alpha-2 antagonist that counteracts terazosin's therapeutic action
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient to discontinue yohimbine

avoid_supplements.name: Ephedra/Ma huang
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Sympathomimetic stimulant that opposes alpha-1 blockade and increases blood pressure, reducing terazosin efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; advise patient to avoid all ephedra-containing products

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may increase terazosin metabolism, potentially reducing serum concentrations
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced efficacy; counsel on potential need for dose adjustment by prescriber

caution_supplements.name: Saw palmetto
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive alpha-1 blockade effects may potentiate hypotensive response
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; assess for orthostatic hypotension symptoms

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase terazosin bioavailability and serum concentrations
caution_foods.action: Limit grapefruit consumption; monitor for increased side effects (dizziness, orthostatic hypotension)

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive sodium intake may counteract antihypertensive effects of terazosin
caution_foods.action: Counsel on DASH diet principles; monitor blood pressure control

monitoring_notes: Monitor for orthostatic hypotension, dizziness, and syncope—counsel on slow position changes and fall risk. Assess blood pressure control at follow-up and counsel patient to report new or worsening symptoms of syncope or presyncope.
